text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Just one more step... one more step
forward!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Show me the path to victory, on this
stage of
elite racers—on this first step
toward my future.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hah.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
No way am I walking away from this

empty-handeeeed!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah... Damn it...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: My stupid heart won't calm down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Nakayama Festa finishes the
Satsuki Sho,
she's making her way to the
waiting room when...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Nakayama Festa!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
You've just ran in the Satsuki Sho, but
are you
still planning on entering the
Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Did she really just say yes?! She
must really
think she's hot stuff.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her response draws a reaction from the
reporters.
The television crew, with
cameras in hand, are
unsure whether to
start filming her or not.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Just roll the cameras already...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Get this so all the people at home will
know—I'm
gonna demonstrate my
strength in the Triple
Crown and then
show everyone that winning the
Prix de
l'Arc de Triomphe isn't simply a dream.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
That's a bold statement, Nakayama
Festa.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
No one's managed to win the Arc. Not
the last
challenger, and not even a triple
crown champion.
All you've done is
finish the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Round Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa, could I have a few
words?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sure?

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Round Glasses
text_block_list.text:
I've been following you since before
your debut.

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Round Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Back then, you argued that you'd
surpass El
Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Round Glasses
text_block_list.text:
You challenged her to a race, then
closed in on
her with your raw power,
seeking to reach the
world stage.
However...

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Round Glasses
text_block_list.text:
With your skills at present, if you could
go up
against El Condor Pasa as she was
during her
classic year, do you think
you'd win?

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Round Glasses
text_block_list.text:
You could blame the media for its
hyperbole, but
plenty of Umamusume
prematurely convince
themselves that
their skills are world-class.

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Round Glasses
text_block_list.text:
You should consider your words more
seriously.

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Round Glasses
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa—one of the most elite
runners
we've ever known—managed to
show us the
international stage.

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Round Glasses
text_block_list.text: And it seems to me that you're conflating her progress with yours and everyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...So we're just blindly chasing after El's
little
moment in the limelight. Is that
what you're
saying?

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Round Glasses
text_block_list.text: Yes, and that's why you should really consider whether you are capable of achieving her dream.

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Round Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Compared to El Condor Pasa, your
ability is—

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Round Glasses
choice_data_list: ええ、世界を獲れる器です

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to burst your bubble, but we
couldn't really
care less what anyone
else thinks.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I hear what you're suggesting—El and I do have different skill sets.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But you're the only one here who thinks
that
means I should give up.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone wants to see it happen. We've
got the
same dream, so let's chase it
together. Let's go all
in, reality be
damned.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you hope. Just wait for the
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Jordan! Have you got a goal in mind
for your
next race?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I know it may be hard, but having
something to
keep you motivated can
help you through your
recovery.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You betcha. I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haha... so annoying. Goals, dreams...
What a load
of crap.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: The Classics have already begun.
